item.title: CQL Capital Leads Strategic Investment In Concrete Batching Solutions Leader Erie Strayer
item.description: CQL Capital announced a strategic investment in Erie Strayer, a fourth-generation, family-owned company specializing in concrete batching solutions. The transaction is designed to support Erie Strayer’s long-term growth initiatives while preserving its legacy, leadership structure, and customer-focused culture. item.title: Simplicity Group Acquires LeSourd Partners To Expand Brokerage General Agency Capabilities
item.description: Simplicity Group, a holistic financial planning firm that integrates wealth accumulation and financial protection strategies, announced it has acquired LeSourd Partners, a Birmingham, Alabama-based brokerage general agency. The transaction expands Simplicity’s national footprint and adds industry veterans Jake LeSourd, Diane Covin, and Kim Roberts as new Partners within the organization. item.title: PlayPower To Acquire Playground Equipment Manufacturer BCI Burke
item.description: PlayPower, an outdoor recreation and living systems company, announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire BCI Burke, a manufacturer of commercial playground equipment. The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Financial terms were not disclosed.
